additions: (14) as peace officers to provide security and protection to the chief justice in the manner and to the extent determined to be necessary after consultation with the chief justice or a designee. Pursuant to this clause, members of the State Patrol acting as peace officers have the same powers with respect to the enforcement of laws relating to crimes as sheriffs and police officers have within their respective jurisdictions.

$101,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the supreme court to provide security for the chief justice. This appropriation is added to the base beginning in fiscal year 2028.
